answer: Cross-chain identity binding: a miner must prove control of one address on each of ≥3 independent chains, hashed into its PoA identity. Each chain acts as an island whose state roots are the vine linking them — forging one requires rewriting history there too. A mirror check re-derives the composite ID from every chain each epoch; mismatches zero rewards. Attack cost is thus 3× the weakest chain's 51% plus ongoing reorg risk. It works because sybil identities fragment across chains, while honest identity consolidates.
